claims.statement: [[CreativeAbstraction]] helps learners keep motivation in complex domains by replacing exhaustive memorization with pattern seeking, general principles, and references for detail lookup.

summary: The new psychology and personal-development topic centers on motivation for learning. Goals are useful when they protect curiosity, build value around knowledge, and guide learners toward abstraction, but they can be counterproductive when they become imposed pressure or credential compliance.
